Date: Fri, 6 Mar 2026 15:10:00 -0700
Subject: Acme POC: Post-call recap & integration plan

Hi Alejandro —

Thanks again for the time today. Quick recap and proposed next steps for the POC Trial we discussed (aim: evaluate Redwood for real-time chat summarization and structured tool-calling for your support assistant):

1) Success criteria (customer-facing):
- 90% accuracy on intent classification for top-5 intents vs baseline ruleset
- Average response latency < 250ms 95th percentile for 1k QPS simulated load
- Structured tool-calling reliability: 99% of calls produce valid JSON schema outputs

2) Scope of integration for the trial:
- Send chat messages to Redwood via our streaming API (gRPC/HTTP2 streaming)
- Use function/tool calling for the knowledge-base lookup + ticket creation flow
- Integrate SDK in your Node.js backend (we'll provide snippets)

3) Proposed timeline:
- Week 1 (Mar 8–12): SDK drop + integration kickoff, sample dataset upload
- Week 2 (Mar 15–19): Integration + wiring of tool-calls, early smoke tests
- Week 3 (Mar 22–26): Load testing, quality evaluation against your test prompts
- Week 4 (Mar 29–Apr 2): Joint review, handover doc + next steps for production

4) Ownership:
- Redwood: marissa_cole (project lead), dev_patel (integration engineer)
- Acme: Alejandro Ruiz (POC lead), acme-eng@acme.com (implementation team)

5) Immediate asks for your team before kickoff:
- Confirm the dataset subset we should use for intent/KB testing (sample s3 link or paste).
- Shared Slack channel or primary contact for real-time debugging.
- Approve the timeline above or propose adjustments.

Attached: redwood-poc-plan.pdf (high-level plan) and integration-snippets.zip (Node/Go examples).

If that looks good I’ll schedule a 30-min kickoff Monday to align owners and walk the integration snippets.

Best,
Marissa
Account Executive | Redwood Inference

Looping in a few technical notes for the kickoff:

- Measurement for "90%": we recommend using top-1 accuracy + per-intent precision/recall and report F1. We'll deliver an evaluation notebook that computes all three.
- Regional latency: Redwood has edge POPs in us-east and us-west; p95=250ms from us-east for streaming with 1k concurrent connections is achievable with the recommended batch size and KV cache enabled. We'll include perf knobs in the doc.
- Tool-calling schema: SDK includes a schema validator that can mark fields optional. We'll show how to set a strict vs. permissive mode.

I'll prepare the Node SDK sample and an internal checklist (auth, endpoints, streaming vs single-request) before Monday.
